correctness.rationale: Both strong reductions were reconstructed with postprocessors that use only oracle outputs. Marker colors encode the finite tuple or palette length, tag residue classes prevent channel collisions, and the bound conversion floor((b+1)/3) was checked for every residue class modulo 3. Small ultimately periodic instances pass exhaustive replay.

originality.rationale: The 2018 source gives the ECT and minECT degree decompositions, while the later color-basis work studies exact persistent colors. Targeted literature and semantic comparisons found no equivalent or stronger result combining them into the palette-certified strong product factorization. The assessment remains best-of-knowledge rather than exhaustive.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a sharp information decomposition: exact persistent-palette data supplies exactly the ordinary Weihrauch strength separating an arbitrary ECT witness from the least ECT witness, and the strong product statement identifies the source of that extra strength.
